8. **Collaboration Inquiry**: Sophia Martinez (Head of Marketing, Fashion Forward) inquires about a partnership for an upcoming influencer campaign for their summer collection.
9. **Rebranding Proposal**: Derek Scott (CEO, Eco-Friendly Packaging Solutions) requests a rebranding proposal to reflect sustainability and innovation.
